# `third_party/room3-maven` — published output of `third_party/room3`

Local Maven repository that alone serves `androidx.room3:room3-runtime-rebuild*`
(`exclusiveContent` in `settings.gradle.kts`), the source-built patched Room 3.0.3
runtime. Contents are generated by `./gradlew -p third_party/room3 publish`; provenance,
the patch and the removal condition live in [`../room3/README.md`](../room3/README.md).
The artifacts are Apache-2.0 (upstream Room): their POMs declare the license and each
binary carries upstream's `LICENSE.txt` (its presence is asserted by
[`../room3/check-parity.sh`](../room3/check-parity.sh)).
